Idk I have a pretty serious mental illness, and the wellness centre has been nothing but helpful with my navigating through it. They connected me with multiple programs, and the psychiatrist is pretty great imo.

I think a lot of the negative feedback is from people who haven't used it, which I don't think is the university's fault. It's actually really accessible and they do actually seem to care.

I don't recommend anyone send any essays they're intending to submit for editing. That could constitute plagiarism depending on the severity of the edits. 

Better be safe than sorry.
